question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (2)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**fishermen**" refers to people whose occupation is catching fish, crucial for coastal communities.
 
• The Deep Ocean Mission ensures that it will not affect the livelihood of fishermen who depend on marine resources.
 
• The other options: "sculptors," "sailors," and "guards" do not fit the context of the sentence.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Deep Ocean Mission would not result in any over-exploitation of marine resources by corporate houses and will not affect the life and livelihoods of fishermen__ in the country.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Sculptors:** artists who carve or shape figures from materials.
 
• **Sailors:** people who work on ships or boats, primarily in navigation or operation.
 
• **Guards:** persons who protect or supervise places or people.
